featured.title: Vulcan failure investigation focuses on ‘inadequate fuel supply’ to booster engines
featured.excerpt: United Launch Alliance said Wednesday that a preliminary review of flight data points to an inadequate supply of fuel to the Blue Origin-manufactured engines of its Vulcan rocket, rather than a problem with the engines themselves, as the reason Sunday's launch fell short of orbit with 40 Amazon Leo internet satellites aboard.
featured.summary: United Launch Alliance's preliminary review attributes the Vulcan launch's failure to orbit, with 40 Amazon Leo satellites aboard, to an inadequate fuel supply to the Blue Origin-manufactured booster engines rather than a fault with the engines themselves.
